name: Prep for Combined Wall+Ceiling Finish
intent: Inspect + repair primed walls AND ceiling in one prep pass. Two inspects (each target their substrate-specific ps_key for quantity attribution), spackle/sand/spot-prime per substrate, then ONE combined vacuum pass (the painter sweeps the room once, not once per substrate).
doctrine: Mirrors the separate-mode prep modules (MOD_PREP_INSPECT_REPAIR + MOD_PREP_INSPECT_REPAIR_CEILING) but drops TSK_DUST_WIPE_WALL in favor of a single ceiling-focused vacuum (TSK_VACUUM_REPAIR_DUST_CEILING) that sweeps the whole room's subfloor. This is the intended dedup — the painter doesn't vacuum twice. Substrate-specific inspect/spackle/sand/spot-prime tasks preserve per-substrate quantification.
